mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_planning_request (id, itinerary_id, owner_member_id, schema_version, start_date, end_date, budget_amount, budget_currency, party_size, preferences_json, status, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{itineraryId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{budgetAmount}, #{budgetCurrency}, #{partySize}, CAST(#{preferencesJson} AS JSON), #{status}, #{version})
mapper.update: UPDATE itinerary_planning_request SET schema_version = #{schemaVersion}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, budget_amount = #{budgetAmount}, budget_currency = #{budgetCurrency}, party_size = #{partySize}, preferences_json = CAST(#{preferencesJson} AS JSON), status = 'DRAFT', version = #{version}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} AND itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND version = #{version} - 1 AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'READY', 'FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT id, itinerary_id, owner_member_id, schema_version, start_date, end_date, budget_amount, budget_currency, party_size, preferences_json, status, version FROM itinerary_planning_request WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_planning_destination (id, planning_request_id, name, country_code, time_zone, position) VALUES (#{id}, #{planningRequestId}, #{name}, #{countryCode}, #{timeZone}, #{position})

INSERT INTO itinerary_revision_proposal (id, planning_request_id, itinerary_id, owner_member_id, base_itinerary_version, contract_version, status, provider, provider_run_id, model_name, workflow_version, knowledge_reference_ids_json, elapsed_millis, total_tokens, failure_code) VALUES (#{id}, #{planningRequestId}, #{itineraryId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{baseItineraryVersion}, #{contractVersion}, #{status}, #{provider}, #{providerRunId}, #{modelName}, #{workflowVersion}, CAST(#{knowledgeReferenceIdsJson} AS JSON), #{elapsedMillis}, #{totalTokens}, #{failureCode})

INSERT INTO itinerary_revision_operation (id, proposal_id, operation_key, operation_type, target_date, target_item_id, summary, payload_json, estimated_cost_delta, validation_status, position) VALUES (#{id}, #{proposalId}, #{operationKey}, #{operationType}, #{targetDate}, #{targetItemId}, #{summary}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS JSON), #{estimatedCostDelta}, #{validationStatus}, #{position})
mapper.update: UPDATE itinerary_revision_proposal SET status = 'EXPIRED', resolved_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{proposalId} AND status = 'READY'
mapper.select: SELECT id, planning_request_id, itinerary_id, owner_member_id, base_itinerary_version, contract_version, status, provider, provider_run_id, model_name, workflow_version, knowledge_reference_ids_json, elapsed_millis, total_tokens, failure_code FROM itinerary_revision_proposal WHERE id = #{proposalId}

SELECT id, planning_request_id, itinerary_id, owner_member_id, base_itinerary_version, contract_version, status, provider, provider_run_id, model_name, workflow_version, knowledge_reference_ids_json, elapsed_millis, total_tokens, failure_code FROM itinerary_revision_proposal WHERE planning_request_id = #{requestId} AND owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, proposal_id, operation_key, operation_type, target_date, target_item_id, summary, payload_json, estimated_cost_delta, validation_status, position FROM itinerary_revision_operation WHERE proposal_id = #{proposalId} ORDER BY position, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_revision_resolution (id, proposal_id, member_id, decision_id, decision_type, selected_operations_hash, expected_itinerary_version, itinerary_command_id, result_version) VALUES (#{id}, #{proposalId}, #{memberId}, #{decisionId}, #{decisionType}, #{selectedOperationsHash}, #{expectedItineraryVersion}, #{itineraryCommandId}, #{resultVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE itinerary_revision_proposal SET status = #{status}, resolved_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{proposalId} AND status = 'READY'
